tests.name: uploads only ciphertext and persists an owned durable reference

does not mark a provider failure as a completed upload
rejects another tenant's, deleted, or missing asset before attachment
accepts unchanged legacy references but rejects new arbitrary URLs
does not fetch or disclose an asset from another tenant
decrypts authenticated bytes and verifies integrity
never deletes an attached or foreign asset
serializes deletion against attachment and keeps a retryable tombstone
runs real encryption and decryption through explicit local storage without provider calls
does not accept an incorrect local ciphertext storage acknowledgement
rejects local locators through default read and delete transports before network calls
rejects test transport injection outside the test environment
retains a retryable local delete until the storage removal succeeds
